ResearchProjectDef.label: Animal bionics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial arm for animals. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage. It is better than a biological arm in almost every way.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Animal prosthetics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechanical replacement arm for animals. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real arm.
